name: af3_submit_prediction
description: Submit AlphaFold 3 all-atom structure prediction via a Vertex AI PipelineJob calling the AF3 Endpoint. Supports proteins, RNA, DNA, ligands (CCD codes or SMILES), and ions in Full 630 GB MSA + PDB templates mode (default: msa_free=false) or --msa-free zero-MSA mode.

input.description: Input sequence in FASTA format, AF3 JSON format, or path to input file / GCS URI. FASTA is automatically converted to AF3 JSON format.

msa_free.description: Whether to skip genetic database search and run in zero-MSA / --msa-free mode for fast screening (default: false; runs full 630 GB MSA + PDB templates by default).

model_seeds.description: Random seed(s) for diffusion generation. Auto-defaults to [1] (1 seed x 5 diffusion samples = 5 structures) for monomers or msa_free=true, and [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] (5 seeds x 5 diffusion samples = 25 structures) for Full-MSA multimers/complexes (>1 chain).

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

sync.description: Wait synchronously in-process instead of submitting a Vertex AI PipelineJob (default: false).

name: af3_submit_batch
description: Submit a batch of AlphaFold 3 predictions as asynchronous Vertex AI PipelineJobs that coordinate access to the H100 endpoint replica(s) via GCS slot locks.

batch_config.description: List of AF3 job configurations (each with 'input', optional 'job_name', 'msa_free', 'model_seeds'). Auto-defaults model_seeds to [1] (5 samples) for monomers/msa-free and [1,2,3,4,5] (25 samples) for Full-MSA multimers/complexes.

name: af3_check_endpoint
description: Inspect health, active deployment status, hardware configuration, and cost state of the AlphaFold 3 Agent Platform Endpoint.

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

name: af3_get_results
description: Retrieve AlphaFold 3 prediction results from GCS. Returns ranking_score, pTM, ipTM, mean pLDDT, and mmCIF structure path.

name: af3_open_viewer
description: Open the FoldRun 3D structure viewer for AlphaFold 3 predictions. Renders all-atom mmCIF structure with pLDDT coloring and ligand visualization.
